name: -8AN PTFE Hose End Replacement Ferrule/Olive Inserts
title: -8AN PTFE Hose End Replacement Ferrule/Olive Inserts
description:
The -8AN PTFE Hose End Replacement Ferrule/Olive Inserts is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, the products are designed for all flavors of motorsports.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
• Compatibility: Engineered specifically for PTFE hose. Impervious to E85, race gas, methanol, and power steering fluid.
